Alger, 10 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech): Algiers, September 10, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Apple unveiled the iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone. The device was presented by the new CEO John Ternus during the fall keynote.

Le nouveau terminal adopte un format com: The new terminal adopts a compact format known as "passport". Once closed, it features a 5.4-inch external screen. Unfolded, its internal Super Retina XDR screen reaches 7.6 inches. This model thus becomes the thinnest iPhone in the brand's history.

This sensor limits video to a 1080p resolution.
Ce design pliable impose des compromis t: This foldable design imposes significant technical compromises. The Face ID facial recognition system disappears. Touch ID makes its return on the lateral power button. In addition, the device skips the telephoto lens.
